prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Living in an increasingly competitive world, college students should better prepare themselves to confront various challenges.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: Living in an increasingly competitive world, college students should better prepare themselves to confront various challenges.
body: Living in an increasingly competitive world, college students should better prepare themselves to confront various challenges. Whether it is a tough job market, rapid technological change or an unexpected setback, the challenges awaiting today’s graduates are more complex than ever before.

Good preparation involves more than earning high grades. First, students need solid professional knowledge and practical skills, which they can gain through internships, research projects and academic competitions. Second, they should develop the habit of lifelong learning, because some of what they learn in college may soon become outdated. Third, and perhaps most importantly, they must build mental strength so that setbacks do not defeat them. A senior student I know failed his first three job interviews, but instead of losing heart, he analyzed his weaknesses, practiced with friends and finally received an offer from a company he had long admired.

In short, challenges are inevitable, but they need not be frightening. In fact, every challenge we overcome makes us stronger. If college students make full use of their four years to sharpen their skills and strengthen their character, they will be able to face whatever comes their way with calm and confidence.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: It is believed that teachers can exert a profound influence on their students’ academic pursuit and personal development.
body: It is believed that teachers can exert a profound influence on their students’ academic pursuit and personal development. Beyond passing on knowledge, a good teacher can shape how students think, what they value and even which path they choose in life.

In academic pursuit, teachers act as guides who spark curiosity. An inspiring lecture or a single word of encouragement may awaken a lifelong interest in a subject. My high school physics teacher, for example, often used simple experiments to explain difficult concepts, and it was in her class that I first dreamed of becoming an engineer, a dream I am still pursuing today. In personal development, teachers serve as role models. Their honesty, patience and sense of responsibility quietly teach students how to treat others and how to cope with difficulties.

Given such influence, teachers should not only improve their teaching skills but also care about the growth of every student, especially those who are struggling. Students, in turn, should seize every chance to ask questions and learn from their teachers, both in and outside the classroom. When teachers and students respect and inspire each other, education can truly fulfill its purpose.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: While striving for the Chinese Dream, young people enjoy more opportunities to realize their self-worth.
body: While striving for the Chinese Dream, young people enjoy more opportunities to realize their self-worth. As the country develops rapidly, fields such as science and technology, rural development and cultural innovation are opening their doors wide to young talent. Today’s young people have more ways than ever to turn their talents into achievements.

These opportunities come in many forms. Young researchers are taking part in major national projects, from space exploration to new energy, and many of them are making their mark at an early age. Other young people choose to return to their hometowns to start businesses, selling local products online, creating jobs and helping their neighbors earn a better living. In serving the development of the nation, they also find a sense of purpose and achievement that money alone cannot bring. For them, personal success and national progress go hand in hand.

Of course, opportunity favors those who are prepared. Young people should study hard, think independently and have the courage to take on difficult tasks. Only by linking their personal dreams with the future of the nation can they truly realize their self-worth and contribute to the Chinese Dream.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: With the increasing application of AI technology, there is a growing concern that it may negatively impact human creativity.
body: With the increasing application of AI technology, there is a growing concern that it may negatively impact human creativity. Now that AI can write poems, compose music and create paintings in seconds, some people fear that we will gradually stop thinking for ourselves.

This concern is not groundless. When a ready-made answer is just a click away, students may be tempted to let AI write their essays instead of struggling with their own ideas, yet it is exactly through such struggle that creativity grows. Over time, overreliance on AI could weaken our imagination. However, AI is not the enemy. Used wisely, it can free us from repetitive work and offer fresh inspiration. A designer, for instance, can generate dozens of sketches with AI and then devote more time to refining the most original one.

The key, therefore, lies in how we use AI. We should treat AI as an assistant rather than a substitute, using it to explore possibilities while keeping the final judgment in our own hands. Schools should encourage students to think independently before turning to AI for help. In this way, AI can enrich human creativity instead of replacing it.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: As requirements for job applications are getting increasingly higher, college students ought to be better prepared for their future career.
body: As requirements for job applications are getting increasingly higher, college students ought to be better prepared for their future career. Employers today expect not only good academic records but also practical experience, teamwork skills and the ability to adapt quickly to new situations.

To meet these expectations, students should start planning early. In their first year, they can explore their interests and set clear career goals. After that, they should build relevant skills step by step, for example by doing internships or joining research projects related to their major. Equally important are soft skills such as communication and problem-solving, which can be developed through club activities and volunteer work. A classmate of mine who wanted to work in marketing spent two summers interning at local companies, and this experience helped her stand out among many applicants and secure the position she wanted.

In addition, students should keep an eye on changes in the job market and update their knowledge accordingly. Career preparation is not a last-minute task before graduation but a process that runs through the whole of college life. Those who prepare early and steadily will be ready when opportunities arrive.

You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
first: As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly.
body: As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly. Platforms such as WeChat and Weibo have made it easier than ever to share information, but they have also brought problems such as rumors, online abuse and addiction.

Using social media properly means, first of all, using it in moderation. Spending hours scrolling through endless posts not only wastes valuable time but also harms our sleep and concentration. Using it responsibly means thinking twice before posting or sharing anything. A rumor forwarded carelessly can cause panic, and a thoughtless comment may deeply hurt someone we have never met. Moreover, we should protect our own privacy and respect that of others, since personal information, once posted online, is very hard to take back.

To achieve this, each of us should develop good habits, such as setting time limits and checking the source of a message before passing it on. Platforms, for their part, should strengthen supervision and remove false or harmful content promptly. Only when everyone acts responsibly can social media become a truly positive force in our lives.
